messages:
ingest-bot: Alert — otel-exporter queue depth for service=api-gateway jumped to 1.2k, ~30 spans dropped last 10m. https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/5678

Mia Chen: seeing truncated traces for /v2/generate around that time. frontend shows 200s but child spans are missing.

Samir Patel: can you share an example trace id and any traceparent header? I'll correlate with collector logs.

Mia Chen: trace id `d9a3c2e6e9b14f49a3d4c1b29f3f2a7b`. Gateway header: `traceparent: 00-d9a3c2e6e9b14f49a3d4c1b29f3f2a7b-7b6f3e4a2c4d5e6f-01`

Kevin Liu: looking at otel-collector on prod. Seeing repeated `failed to export traces: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed` from exporter client.

Olivia Park: FYI last week's infra change set accidentally set span retention to `6h` for the new bucket; that seems wrong compared to the intended 30d.

Samir Patel: immediate vector is exporter backpressure. Collector's sending_queue is filling; retry config looks wrong in the rollout (defaults used).

Kevin Liu: found collector.yaml in deployment: `exporters.otlp.timeout: 2s` and no explicit `retry_on_failure.max_interval`. Also `sending_queue.max_size: 500` — too low for bursty traffic.

Mia Chen: can we hotpatch the collector config for canary? Propose bump timeout and queue.

Samir Patel: Proposed snippet:
```
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: exporter.internal:4317
    timeout: 10s
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp]
  extensions: {}
retry_on_failure:
  enabled: true
  initial_interval: 5s
  max_interval: 30s
  max_elapsed_time: 300s
sending_queue:
  max_size: 2000
batch:
  send_size: 100
  timeout: 5s
```

Kevin Liu: lowered batch size so individual RPCs are smaller, increased queue. Starting canary patch now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: collector:v2026-03-19-hotfix to prod-cluster-a (1/3 pods)

Mia Chen: canary logs show backlog draining, dropped spans per minute down from ~30 -> 0.

ingest-bot: Alert resolved — otel-exporter queue depth back to nominal (≈45), no new dropped spans.

Olivia Park: follow-up items: 1) add exporter queue depth metric to Console dashboards (per-cluster), 2) alert at 200 queue depth, 3) schema validation for retention flags in infra PR.

Samir Patel: opening a small ticket for dashboard + alert + playbook. assigning to Olivia for dashboard, Kevin for schema PR.

Kevin Liu: will open infra PR to validate retention config and add unit test against copy-paste mistakes.

Mia Chen: saved the problematic trace ids and attached exporter logs in the incident doc. Thanks for the quick canary.

Olivia Park: :thumbsup: Nice catch — and nice quick mitigation.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: rollout succeeded to 3/3 clusters (collector:v2026-03-19-hotfix).
